cases.d: Verify every AdminUsers route returns 401 to an anonymous caller.
steps: Without authentication, send each request: GET /api/users, POST /api/users, PUT /api/users/<id>, PUT /api/users/<id>/status, POST /api/users/<id>/password-reset, GET /api/roles, POST /api/roles, PUT /api/roles/<id>, DELETE /api/roles/<id>, GET /api/roles/capabilities, PUT /api/roles/capabilities.
Request headers: None (no authentication).
exp: No data is returned and nothing is changed.

cases.d: Verify every AdminUsers route returns 403 to a signed-in user without AdminUsers.
steps: Send each AdminUsers request (users, roles and role matrix routes) with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of thuky@trustcabinet.local>.
exp: Nothing is written to the audit log.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (Secretary, MeetingCreator, no AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify a token claiming a capability the role no longer has is refused.
steps: Sign in as quantri@trustcabinet.local and keep the access token.
On the role matrix, untick AdminUsers for the Admin role and tick MeetingCreator instead (another administrator role keeps AdminUsers).
Send GET request to /api/users with the access token from step 1.
exp: The server reads the role from the database, not from the token.
pre: Another active account with AdminUsers exists, so the change is allowed.

cases.d: Verify the token of a deactivated account is refused.
steps: Sign in as a second administrator and keep the access token.
As quantri@trustcabinet.local, deactivate that administrator.
Send GET request to /api/users with the kept access token.
pre: A second active administrator account exists.

cases.d: Verify a token whose account no longer exists is refused.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token signed by the server for an account id that does not exist in the database>

pre: A test access token is issued for an account that is not in the users table.

cases.d: Verify an unknown user id returns 404 with an empty body.
steps: Send GET request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local> with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of quantri@trustcabinet.local>.
Send GET request to /api/users/<random UUID that no account has> with the same header.
exp: The first request returns HTTP 200 OK.
The second request returns HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body.

cases.d: Verify every capability (MeetingCreator, MeetingApprover, MinutesEditor, AdminUsers) has an authorization policy.
steps: Start the backend.
For each capability, call one endpoint gated by it with a user holding that capability.
exp: No request fails with HTTP 500 because a policy is missing.
pre: Accounts holding each capability exist (thuky: MeetingCreator, chutoa: MeetingApprover, quantri: AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify GET /api/auth/me returns the capability set the interface renders from.
exp: capabilities is ["MeetingCreator", "MinutesEditor"] and does not contain AdminUsers.
pre: The Secretary role has MeetingCreator and MinutesEditor in the role matrix.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/auth/me answers from the database, not from the token.
steps: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the access token.
As quantri@trustcabinet.local, change thuky's role to Member.
Send GET request to /api/auth/me with the kept access token.
pre: Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local in another browser.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/auth/me is refused once the account is deactivated.
steps: Sign in as a second administrator and keep the access token.
As quantri@trustcabinet.local, deactivate that administrator.
Send GET request to /api/auth/me with the kept access token.
pre: A second active administrator account exists.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/auth/me is refused for a token whose subject is no account.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token signed by the server with no usable account id>

pre: A test access token without a valid account id is prepared.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/auth/me is refused without a token.
Verify every /api/roles route returns 401 to an anonymous caller.
steps: Without authentication, send GET /api/roles, POST /api/roles, PUT /api/roles/<id> and DELETE /api/roles/<id>.

cases.d: Verify every /api/roles route returns 403 without AdminUsers.
steps: Send GET /api/roles, POST /api/roles, PUT /api/roles/<id> and DELETE /api/roles/<id> with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of thuky@trustcabinet.local>.
exp: Nothing is written to the audit log.

cases.d: Verify a token claiming AdminUsers is refused once its account is deactivated.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of an administrator who has since been deactivated>

exp: No role is created; the role list still has only the four built-in roles.
pre: The administrator signed in, kept the access token and was then deactivated.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/roles returns every role with its user count in display order.
exp: The four built-in roles come first (Chủ toạ, Thư ký, Thành viên, Quản trị viên), then custom roles.
Chủ toạ has isBuiltIn true, a description and userCount 3.
The custom role "Thư ký phó" has isBuiltIn false and userCount 0.
pre: Three accounts hold the Chair role.
A custom role "Thư ký phó" with no account exists.

cases.d: Verify POST /api/roles creates a role and returns MSG19 with 201 and a Location header.

req.body: { "name": "Thư ký phó", "description": "Hỗ trợ thư ký soạn biên bản.", "capabilities": ["MinutesEditor"] }

exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG19", message "Tạo vai trò thành công.".
role.name "Thư ký phó", isBuiltIn false, userCount 0.
Location header is /api/roles/<new id>; the role matrix shows MinutesEditor ticked for it.
pre: No role is named "Thư ký phó".

cases.d: Verify creating a role records the signed-in administrator as the actor.
steps: Open the audit_log table and find the newest row.
pre: No role is named "Thư ký phó".

cases.d: Verify a role can be created without capabilities.
exp: The new role has no capability in the role matrix.

cases.d: Verify POST /api/roles returns MSG20 with 400 naming every invalid field.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG20", message "Thông tin vai trò không hợp lệ.".
errors has exactly capabilities, description and name; the capabilities error names DeleteEverything.

cases.d: Verify an empty JSON object returns MSG20 rather than a binding error.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG20".

cases.d: Verify creating and renaming a role with no body at all returns MSG20.
steps: Send POST request to /api/roles with header Content-Type: application/json, the administrator's token and an empty body.
Repeat with the body null.
Send PUT request to /api/roles/<id of the custom role> with an empty body, then with null.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG20".

cases.d: Verify POST /api/roles returns MSG21 with 409 for a name already used, ignoring case.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG21", message "Đã có vai trò dùng tên này. Hãy đặt một tên khác.".

cases.d: Verify POST /api/roles returns MSG26 with 500 when the database is unavailable.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG26", message "Không thể tạo vai trò. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/roles/{id} renames a custom role and returns MSG22.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG22", message "Cập nhật vai trò thành công.".
One role.updated entry is written to the audit log.
pre: Custom role "Thư ký phó" exists and two accounts hold it.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/roles/{id} ignores capabilities sent in the body.
exp: The role still has no capability in the role matrix; capabilities change only through PUT /api/roles/capabilities.
pre: Custom role "Thư ký phó" exists with no capability.

cases.d: Verify a built-in role cannot be renamed (MSG24).
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG24", message "Đây là vai trò mặc định của hệ thống, không đổi tên hoặc xoá được. Bạn vẫn sửa được quyền của nó.".

cases.d: Verify renaming a role to another role's name returns MSG21.
Verify a role name longer than 64 characters returns MSG20 on name.
exp: Response JSON body has code "MSG20" and an error on name.

cases.d: Verify renaming an unknown role returns 404 with an empty body.
exp: HTTP 404 Not Found response with an empty body.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/roles/{id} returns MSG27 when the database is unavailable.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG27", message "Không thể cập nhật vai trò. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify DELETE /api/roles/{id} deletes an unused custom role and returns MSG23.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG23", message "Xoá vai trò thành công.".
The role no longer appears in GET /api/roles.
One role.deleted entry is written to the audit log.
pre: Custom role "Thư ký phó" exists and no account holds it.

cases.d: Verify deleting a role still held by accounts returns MSG25 with the account count.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG25", userCount 3, message "Vai trò này vẫn còn 3 tài khoản mang. Hãy chuyển họ sang vai trò khác trước khi xoá.".
pre: Custom role "Thư ký phó" is held by three accounts.

cases.d: Verify a built-in role cannot be deleted (MSG24).
exp: The Member role is still listed.

cases.d: Verify deleting an unknown role returns 404 with an empty body.
exp: HTTP 404 Not Found response with an empty body.

cases.d: Verify a role id that is not a UUID does not match any route.
Verify DELETE /api/roles/{id} returns MSG28 when the database is unavailable.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG28", message "Không thể xoá vai trò. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify the role matrix returns 401 to an anonymous caller.
Verify the role matrix returns 403 without AdminUsers.
Verify a token claiming AdminUsers is refused once the role has lost it.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token issued while the caller's role still had AdminUsers>

pre: The caller's role had AdminUsers when the token was issued and it has since been removed in the role matrix.

cases.d: Verify a deactivated administrator is refused the role matrix even with a valid token.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of an administrator who has since been deactivated>

pre: The administrator signed in, kept the access token and was then deactivated.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/roles/capabilities returns the matrix and the capability catalogue.
exp: roles lists every role; capabilities lists the four capabilities.
The Member role ("Thành viên", isBuiltIn true, with a description) has exactly ["MinutesEditor"].
pre: MinutesEditor is ticked for the Member role.

cases.d: Verify every catalogue entry carries a code and a Vietnamese name.
exp: Every item of capabilities has a non-empty code and a non-empty Vietnamese name.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/roles/capabilities saves a role's capabilities and returns MSG16 with the new matrix.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG16", message "Cập nhật phân quyền thành công.".
In matrix.roles the Member role has exactly ["MeetingCreator"].

cases.d: Verify changing the matrix does not sign out the accounts holding the role.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/roles/capabilities with body { "roleId": "<id of the Member role>", "capabilities": ["MeetingCreator"] }.
Send it again with "capabilities": [].
In the browser where thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is signed in, reload the page.
pre: thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is signed in in another browser.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/roles/capabilities returns MSG18 when the database is unavailable.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG18", message "Không thể cập nhật phân quyền. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify a capability name is accepted in any letter case.
exp: The Member role now has MeetingCreator.

cases.d: Verify removing the last AdminUsers grant is refused with MSG17.
exp: Response JSON body has code "MSG17" ("Cấu hình phân quyền không hợp lệ.") and an error on adminUsers.
pre: The Admin role is the only role with AdminUsers.

cases.d: Verify an unknown roleId returns MSG17 on roleId.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/roles/capabilities with body { "roleId": "01990000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000", "capabilities": ["AdminUsers"] }.
Repeat with "roleId": "Admin".
Repeat with "roleId": "".
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Each response JSON body has code "MSG17" and an error on roleId.

cases.d: Verify an unknown capability returns MSG17 naming it.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG17".

cases.d: Verify every unknown capability is named, not just the first.
exp: errors.capabilities mentions both Nonsense and AlsoWrong.

cases.d: Verify a missing capability list is refused rather than read as empty.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG17".
The Secretary role keeps its capabilities.
pre: The Secretary role has at least one capability.

cases.d: Verify an empty capability list is accepted and removes every capability.
exp: The Secretary role has no capability in the matrix.

cases.d: Verify a rejected matrix change carries a Vietnamese message.
exp: message is "Cấu hình phân quyền không hợp lệ." (Vietnamese text).
